title: Codex Trace local payload contracts
description: Payload schemas only. All source content is untrusted text and remains local. Nullable measurements represent unrecorded values; numeric zero is recorded zero. MCP transport envelope is validated separately.

relatedThreadIds.description: 协作操作中明确记录的相关 Thread ID，仅用于页面跳转，不建立父子关系。

executionIntervals.description: 已记录的轮次执行包络；中断后恢复保留为独立区间，缺失时不从事件或当前时间推造。

TimelineOrigin.description: A stable root-thread creation reference, independent of loaded pages and child scope. It is not the beginning or elapsed duration of a particular execution.

AgentScope.description: Selected scopes contain exact Agent group IDs, including an empty selection. Legacy all/main/group scopes remain readable; group includes descendants.

turnRange.description: 双指针条目高亮范围，保存绝对墙钟时间，仅高亮实际时间相交的记录；不筛除或重排条目。完成选择后可通过独立阅读锚点定位首条命中记录并展开必要路径。缺失或 null 清除高亮，独立于事件筛选和正文搜索。

timelineSpacing.description: 旧时间轴显示偏好，保留读取兼容；新的 Turn 顺序图忽略此值。原始时间、选区和后台查询不随顺序图布局改变。

ExportRequestId.description: Client-generated idempotency key. Permanently binds one create or commit operation to its source instance, task and (for commit) export. Reuse cannot create another file.

LocalExportPath.description: Output only: canonical absolute POSIX or native Windows local-drive path of the verified ZIP beneath the current OS user home Downloads/Codex Trace directory. Windows UNC/device paths, alternate streams, reserved device names, traversal and trailing dots/spaces are excluded. The service enforces exact home containment and rejects symlink/reparse escapes; the schema cannot determine the user home. Network filesystem locking/publication is not part of this contract.

LocalSaveOutcome.description: Only verified confirms a saved ZIP. pending/unknown and transport timeout never mean unsaved. failed is a definitive failed commit with no final file published by this request; uncertain outcomes use unknown. Receipt survives temporary export release.

DownloadResult.description: Snapshot lifecycle and local-save receipt are independent. ready means the frozen ZIP is available, not that it was saved. result can recover by commit requestId when the caller did not receive a response. A missing operation record is unknown, never proof that no file exists.

DownloadRequest.description: Single export interface. create and commit require different idempotency keys; result queries a commit key after timeout without making a new save. Destination and filename are server-owned; no arbitrary client path, filename, overwrite flag or UI filter is accepted.
